summary: The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 4 hours.
body:
[Updated October 29 at 8:54 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 4 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled maintenance starting on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 1:00 PM CET / 11:00 PM AEDT). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 4 hours, concluding around 9:00 AM PDT (12:00 PM EDT / 5:00 PM CET / 3:00 AM AEDT October 30).

Times:

Thursday, October 29, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 9:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 11:00 PM - 3:00 AM October 30

What will be unavailable:

  • All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

  • MapleStory Classic World will be updated to v.1.1.0.
  • Players with an outstanding debt can no longer pick up Mesos or items dropped by other players.
    • Drops from monsters you defeated and certain party quest items can still be picked up. 
  • Kerning City Party Question coupons and passes can still be dropped by players that have an outstanding debt.
  • Added additional items to monster drops in Victoria Island.
  • Decreased the HP of the following monsters:
    • Copper Drake
    • Tortie
    • Clang
    • Drake
  • Woodcrafting (Rank 1): Increased the number of arrows crafted per attempt when converting between Arrow for Bow and Arrow for Crossbow.
    • Arrow for Bow: Increased the amount crafted from 5 → 50, and the required Arrows for Crossbow from 10 → 100.
    • Arrow for Crossbow: Increased the amount crafted from 5 → 50, and the required Arrows for Bow from 10 → 100.
  • Characters must be Lv.10 and above to send whispers.
  • Reduced the Contribution required to reach Citizenship Ranks 4–10 to better match the intended progression pace.

Skill Changes:

  • Archer
    • Focus: Increased Accuracy from 1-20 → 5-25.
  • Wizard (Fire, Poison)
    • Poison Breath: Increased Damage from 50-80 → 60-90.
      • Resolved an issue where the skill did not deal damage properly at Lv. 10.
  • Wizard (Ice, Lightning)
    • Thunder Bolt: Increased Damage from 40-70 → 50-80.
  • Fighter, Page, Spearman
    • Rush: Resolved an issue where the range did not increase from 130 to 150 at Lv. 10 as stated in the skill description.
  • Spearman
    • Final Attack: Spear and Final Attack: Polearm: Resolved an issue where the maximum HP absorbed by the skills did not match the skill description.
      • The maximum HP absorbed is now 15% of Max HP.

Bug Fixes:

  • Resolved an issue where the game client would sometimes disconnect for new players while on Character Select.
  • Resolved an issue where players would sometimes disconnect after changing channels while Final Attack was active.
  • Resolved an issue where players could get stuck in the Free Market.
  • Resolved an issue where the Mushroom Garden map was incorrectly set as a town, preventing the use of Store Permits and the Lie Detector Test item.
  • Resolved an issue where Cash Shop previews would display dye colors from equipped Cash items dyed with the Mystery Palette, instead of the items' default appearance.
  • Resolved an issue where the following Halloween Cash items had no icon:
    • Glowing Pumpkin Basket
    • Evil Skull
    • Cat Soul
  • Resolved an issue where Citizenship daily quests could be completed twice in one day.
  • Resolved an issue where Mark of the Beta items obtained before the Grand Launch had lower Weapon DEF than those obtained after.
name: [Completed] Scheduled Maintenance - October 29, 2026
